## Golden Rule

The E2E test suite must never break during migration. If any E2E test fails at the
end of a phase, the phase is rolled back and the story is reopened.

## Project Overview

Lagrangia MecAI is a CAD code generation system built for Dessia Technologies.

**Stack:** Python, LangGraph, ChromaDB, FastAPI

## Phase Map

Phase 1 — Extract dessia-memory: Isolate ChromaDB memory into standalone package (STORY-001)
Phase 2 — Extract dessia-tools + YAML contract: Tool server extraction + service contract (STORY-002 – STORY-003)

## Repo Ownership

- architect-multiagents → dessia-multiagents/, service_contract.yaml
- dev-memory → dessia-memory/
- tester → full repo (read + bash; no write)
- final-judge → full repo (read only; approval authority)

## Hard Constraints

- No breaking changes to the `dessiaworker` public API at any point during migration
- The CI pipeline must remain green at the end of every story (no red CI merges)
- No files in the monorepo are deleted until Phase 5 is fully validated and signed off by final-judge
- All git commits must reference a STORY-XXX number in the commit message

## Out of Scope for All Agents

- Deleting files from the monorepo before Phase 5 is validated
- Modifying files not listed in the agent's scope
- Merging any PR without final-judge approval
- Pushing with --force to any branch
